sections.heading: Then
sections.copy: JFWO states that manufacturers, designers and distributors cooperate in the organization and that its textile division operates alongside Fashion Week.

sections.heading: Now
sections.copy: Tokyo Textile Scope is a distinct trade-facing surface connected to the same organizational ecosystem.

sections.heading: Next / limit
sections.copy: The public event interface does not prove item-level fiber origin, mill, labor, chemical, inventory or product-passport data for every runway garment.

essay.closing: Tokyo’s technical identity is not one gadget. It is the chain of interfaces that decides what can enter, travel, translate, trade and remain.
